card.statement:
[{<<cite:hon-hor,HJ12>>}] Each square complex matrix is consimilar to a direct sum, uniquely determined up to permutation of direct summands, of matrices of the following three types:

- [Type 0:] $J_k(0),\ k =
      1,2,\dots$;

- [Type I:] $J_k(\lambda  ),\
      k = 1,2,\dots,$ in which $\lambda $ is real and positive;

- [Type II:] $H_{2k}(\mu)$, $k
      = 1,2,\dots,$ in which $\mu $ is either not real or is real and negative.
card.label: Theorem 3

paper.title: Cycles of linear and semilinear mappings
paper.abstract: We give a canonical form of matrices of a cycle of linear or semilinear mapping V_1 --- V_2 --- ... --- V_t --- V_1 in which all V_i are complex vector spaces, each line is an arrow ---> or <---, and each arrow denotes a linear or semilinear mapping.
